name: Quipendo
description: Read-only: copies your Quip folders and documents into a local folder as Markdown, including calendars, Kanban boards, project trackers and spreadsheets.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https://platform.quip.com; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
